li_description:
Every company has a mission. What's ours? To empower every person and every organization to achieve more. We believe technology can and should be a force for good and that meaningful innovation contributes to a brighter world in the future and today. Our culture doesn’t just encourage curiosity; it embraces it. Each day we make progress together by showing up as our authentic selves. We show up with a learn-it-all mentality. We show up cheering on others, knowing their success doesn't diminish our own. We show up every day open to learning our own biases, changing our behavior, and inviting in differences. Because impact matters. 

Microsoft operates in 190 countries and is made up of approximately 228,000 passionate employees worldwide.
website_summary:
Microsoft sells software, cloud, AI, security, collaboration, developer, gaming, and device-related products and services. Page text names Microsoft 365, Azure, Copilot, Windows, Surface, Xbox, Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Teams, Windows 365, Visual Studio, and Microsoft Security.

The homepage describes Microsoft 365 as providing “cloud storage, advanced security, and Microsoft Copilot” in one plan. It describes Teams as online meetings, chat, real-time collaboration, and shared cloud storage; Windows 365 as streaming a Windows experience from the Microsoft cloud to any device; and Azure as supporting systems that learn and adapt. It also sells physical products including Surface computers and accessories, Xbox consoles/controllers, and other PCs and devices. Therefore, software is both a product category and part of offerings alongside non-software devices and gaming hardware.

It addresses personal customers, businesses, small businesses, developers and IT, education, and organizations. The About page states its mission is to empower every person and organization on the planet. The provided text does not specify customer company-size segments beyond “Small Business.”

The homepage includes business offerings such as AI, security, Azure, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 for business, Power Platform, Teams, Windows 365, and digital sovereignty. It also references developers, IT, software companies, and marketplace apps.

**Careers:** The `/careers` page was reachable only as “Sign in.” It contains no engineering hiring, team-growth, or capacity language.

**Product:** The `/product` page was reachable but says the requested page cannot be found. It contains no roadmap, platform-rebuild, or re-platforming language.

**About:** The `/about` page was reachable. It describes Microsoft’s mission, organization, values, sustainability, social responsibility, stories, and AI, but does not provide hiring or product-roadmap details.

Pages reachable: homepage, /about, /product, /careers
